question: Should a declared plugin setup credential be a hard readiness prerequisite in the public `claws add --dry-run` plan, even though package installation itself can proceed?
rationale: The patch makes readiness more truthful, but it changes the observable contract for structured dry-run consumers and operators; that policy cannot be inferred solely from the implementation.

options.title: Adopt setup-gated readiness
options.body: Merge the feature as proposed and document that plugin packages with declared credentials are not ready until supported setup evidence is present.

options.title: Keep install readiness separate
options.body: Treat package installation as ready while exposing missing setup only as an advisory package-action detail.

options.title: Version the structured plan contract
options.body: Keep the readiness behavior but introduce an explicit compatibility/versioning path for consumers that exhaustively parse prerequisite kinds.

recommendation.title: Adopt setup-gated readiness
recommendation.body: Merge the feature as proposed and document that plugin packages with declared credentials are not ready until supported setup evidence is present.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only evidence-backed current contributor to the affected readiness implementation; repository-area ownership needs maintainer confirmation.
